title: Rebling Quick Disconnect Plugs – Quick Disconnect T Handle
description: 7016 body molded from a chemically resistant and heat resistant plastic Designed to mate with all MS3509 style (Rebling’s 7002 series) receptacles 7016 is identical to Rebling’s 7017 disconnect except the cover length is shorter providing clearance for auxiliary connectors mounted on the battery Compensation for part-to-part dimensional variations and relative mating receptacle contact pins motion Engagement with the receptacle is accomplished by rotating a “T” shaped handle into a detent position Embossed body polarity markings and a molded keyway ensure correct polarity is achieved with the mating receptacle Large contact area of silver-plated copper alloy across socket-receptacle pin interface produces very low electrical losses The 7016-1 has a “T” shaped handle, while the 7016-2 has a round knob
